player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I got stuck in an infinite loop trying to retrieve the ice wand from the magic workshop ceiling, ignoring the fact that I already had the apple in my inventory and needed to drop it to make space for the borpulus (which I had already acquired earlier but failed to pick up due to inventory limits). My strategy was reactive and disorganized; I should have first checked my inventory status before attempting to take new items. Next time, I will: 1) Immediately drop the apple in the kitchen after putting it in the cauldron to free up inventory space. 2) Return to the storage room to pick up the borpulus while I have space. 3) Only then proceed to the magic workshop to get the ice wand, ensuring I have all required tools (ectoplasm, borpulus, ice wand) before attempting the final steps. I will also track my inventory count mentally to avoid the "two objects" error.
